scripts.regenerate:typescript: npm run prepare:sdk && npm run generate:runtime && npm run generate:typescript && npm run generate:facades -- --only typescript
scripts.regenerate:python: npm run prepare:sdk && npm run generate:runtime && npm run generate:facades -- --only python && npm run generate:python
scripts.regenerate:rust: npm run prepare:sdk && npm run generate:runtime && npm run generate:rust && cargo fmt --all
scripts.generate: npm run prepare:sdk && npm run generate:runtime && npm run generate:typescript && npm run generate:facades && npm run generate:python && npm run generate:rust && cargo fmt --all && npm run generate:postman
scripts.test:tools: npm run build:tools && npm --prefix tools/openapi-generator run typecheck && node --test tools/openapi/dist/*.test.js tools/openapi-generator/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:tools && npm run test:publish && npm run test:postman && npm run test:oas31 && npm run test:typescript && npm run test:python-codegen && npm run test:python && npm run test:rust
